company.shortDescription: Bayzat is a technology SaaS company that provides insurance, payroll, and human resources solutions for businesses.
company.description:
Bayzat is a technology SaaS company that provides insurance, payroll, and human resources software solutions for businesses. It helps companies provide their employees with a better experience by automating and enhancing their insurance, payroll, and HR administration.  As of today, Bayzat is helping to provide world-class employee experiences to 80,000+ employees.

The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Dubai, UAE.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $25,000,000, or 42.11% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,517,979 to $285,514,779, a 188.09x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
